title: Statistical Guarantees for Reasoning Probes on Looped Boolean Circuits
summary: We study the statistical behavior of reasoning probes in a stylized model of iterative computation inspired by neural algorithmic reasoning. The underlying computation is given by a looped Boolean circuit whose graph is a perfect $ν$-ary tree ($ν\ge 2$), with outputs recursively fed back as inputs across computation rounds. A probe observes a sampled subset of internal nodes and seeks to infer the latent operation at each node, represented as a probability distribution over a finite set of admissible Boolean gates.
